summary: Caledonia Mining Corp Plc filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing a 22% increase in underground measured and indicated mineral resources at Blanket Mine to 2.178 million ounces of gold, plus a surface oxide resource estimate. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is involved. The filing is a routine operational update on resource estimates under NI 43-101, with plans for a technical report and potential mine deepening study. No deal terms, prices, or premiums are stated. This is not a special situation; thus, category is None.
